title: Few improvement on my hexa island builder
author: Old-Wolverine-4134
selftext: Added day/night cycle with occasional storms. Improved overall look and visuals. Fixed some bugs, replaced the character with better one. I continue working on the animations and the bugs. Expect more content soon.

replies.author: eragon1man

replies.author: MrTheWaffleKing
replies.body: It has a built in version of blender and it doesn't need to interface with your own app to do it?

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: It uses my blender but through headless execution - i.e. it does not open the software, but it uses it on its own.

replies.author: Lavio00

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: I am trying out time as cost - time moves only when doing work or placing cards. For instance placing new land tile takes 1 hour. This way you can do only so much in a day/turn. Sill trying to figure out the best approach.

comments.body:
It looks really cool, good job.  

Do you mind if I ask you a basic question, I've done the Claude unity/blender link but all it makes is really ugly basic graphics, how do you manage to make such beautiful graphics with just Claude ?

Thanks a lot, and keep up the good work!

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: It barely used blender. Most of it is made directly in unity. It fits because its low poly game viewed usually from some distance
Thank you, what about all the details like the flowers and butterflies, little bushes ecc... Did Claude do it on its own or you added them manually ?

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: All Claude. Again, all. Nothing is done manually in the game. I don't even open unity except to hit play to preview the game.
Damn, somehow mine cant do that...
